discarded_initial_shared_target.reason: Shared Cargo target mixed baseline dependency metadata into candidate test compile; isolated workspace artifacts and rebuilt both variants

margin_room.scope: Local receipt aggregation only; no benchmark, compiler, server or load process is started.

risk.definition: bounded fixed public-API work; restored position fixtures; warmup and serialization excluded; no service-capacity claim
risk.compiler_interference_observation: Runner checks compiler idle at phase boundaries; risk has no per-run compiler sampler.

view.definition: Paired fixed-state view construction/JSON serialization, without network.
view.compiler_interference_observation: Runner checks compiler idle at phase boundaries; view has no per-run compiler sampler.

sources.scope: same client, same closed-loop fixed work, in-memory journal

room.latency_method: Nearest-rank per-run percentiles from accepted phase=measure requests. Summary medians summarize run percentiles, not pooled request percentiles.
room.percent_change_method: 100*(after_median/before_median-1); negative latency change is an improvement, positive request-throughput change is an improvement.
room.scope: Rust async closed-loop fixed work, in-memory journal, concurrent read probe; warmup excluded; observations do not establish an SLO or capacity.
room.correctness_boundary: Rechecks accepted commands, identities, actual trade/fill counts, aggregate asset conservation, released asset reservations and empty books. Cancel-only additionally requires exact account restoration. Roundtrip may redistribute accounts; no full Perp position/checkpoint equivalence is claimed.
room.topology_boundary: one_book versus four_venues changes state/history distribution as well as lock count; not a pure lock ablation.

data.room_recipe: Spot/Perp; rest_cancel/roundtrip; one_book/four_venues; concurrency 1/8; 2048 total cycles
data.scope: paired Release fixed work on shared hardware; closed-loop observations; no SLO/capacity qualification

audit.frozen_input_hashes_source: Captured benchmark comparisons and runner manifests; current binaries/source are not reread.

room_tail_confirmation.latency_method: Nearest-rank percentiles per measured accepted request run; all summary medians are medians of run metrics, not pooled request percentiles.

interpretation.throughput: Same fixed recipe improved in both ABBA quartets (+9.27%, +10.79%); limited repeatability evidence, not service capacity or SLO qualification.
interpretation.tail: Initial P99 +21.79% did not recur at that magnitude; additional P95 +2.69% and P99 +1.11%. Both quartets retain positive tail median changes and overlapping/interleaved run ranges; no guaranteed tail improvement.
interpretation.background: OBS and other background CPU remain. Initial slower candidate had more recorded activity; correlation does not establish causation.
interpretation.combined: Eight-run combined medians are supplementary descriptive summaries; they do not replace either quartet or erase the first-pass P99 regression.

native_delivery.qualification: Same integrated binary and fixed complete workload; only owned/native delivery changes. Risk, PG and other integrated code are identical in both modes. This is not the overall c5e3c0a-to-8f99502 integration speedup. Elapsed/delivery exclude final receipt serialization; process CPU/RSS include it.

memory_storage.comparison: tight raw JSON versus production lossless compression
memory_storage.qualification: Test allocator diagnostics; requested heap excludes allocator slack, stacks and tracer headers. Peak is requested heap measured before receipt serialization, not RSS. Diagnostic timings are not used to attribute production throughput. New raw/compressed comparison cannot reuse historical spare-capacity/shrink conclusions.

postgres_fixed.qualification: Fixed complete 160-block HTTP/PG trace per run: 1,340 measured requests and 320 trades; warmup excluded. Quantiles use nearest rank and medians are over each run's own quantile, not pooled requests. Query hashes omit only created_at/updated_at. Each case has two same-binary recovery starts, with an idle hard server stop after fixed work and projection drain. PostgreSQL runtime was not restarted; this is not database crash or outstanding-projection crash qualification. Actual asynchronous 1000-bot/25ms throughput is separate.

live.selection_basis: Explicit directory selection by the caller, never based on speed or qualification. Other attempt groups remain in a separate complete appendix with their raw measurements and wrapper failures.
live.provenance_policy: Each backend group must be internally consistent. Cross-backend driver SHA equality is not required: PostgreSQL repairs adapt credential parsing/explicit child connection environment and nullable observation initialization. Nonnull observation fields/percentiles, clock brackets, live workload algorithm, configuration, windows and qualification targets are unchanged. Every earlier group uses its captured original hashes and matching saved original files when available, never repaired current script paths.

manifests.binding_rule: Captured SHA is authoritative; current wrapper/runner paths are never rehashed to replace historical provenance.
Captured SHA is authoritative; current wrapper/runner paths are never rehashed to replace historical provenance.

runner.saved_original_status: unavailable for this captured revision; no current-path substitution

live.scope: Eight planned 1000-bot ABBA cases; bounded asynchronous synthetic load with full scheduler probes in the measured window. Short windows do not establish long-run stability, bounded memory or production capacity.
live.aggregation: All report-producing runs contribute, including invalid, failed-check and unqualified reports; no best-run selection. Median/min/max of per-run statistics are not pooled latency percentiles or SLOs. Null means unavailable, never zero. Each wrapper attempt is preserved separately.
live.freshness_units: simulation milliseconds relative to later committed clock; clock bracket and observer HTTP cost retained, not wall-clock bot latency
live.pg_counts_scope: Growth from pre-window snapshot until final paused read barrier includes post-window drain; not timed trading throughput

interpretation: Risk and view compare c5e3c0a against 8f99502 using identical public-API harnesses.
Native delivery compares owned/native within the integrated plain Release binary; compression compares raw/compressed within a separate allocation-diagnostic binary.
ABBA medians summarize individual runs and run-level quantiles, not pooled request percentiles or universal speed guarantees.
Live workload is asynchronous and nondeterministic; cross-version market receipts need not match. Fixed workload equivalence is verified separately.
All original failed harness attempts and the first tail-regression quartet remain retained.
Full scheduler observation probes every 2s remain part of both live measurements. Simulation observation lag is not wall latency.
The 30s live windows establish bounded observations, not long-duration memory stability or maximum production capacity.
Recovery covers a drained idle application-server hard stop and same-version reader/writer. PostgreSQL was not crashed or restarted during the recovery study.

PostgreSQL final/recovery equivalence covers scheduler, clock, all recipe-account observe responses, and seven business query tables; it does not assert internal MarketState or checkpoint-byte equivalence.
Attributable SQL WAL deltas include projection drain; HTTP and CPU timing stop before drain, so those statistical windows differ.
